edits.new: Write a concise title naming the most specific topic under which all these instances belong in a topic hierarchy. Name the topic itself, rather than describing the instances as text. If every instance expresses the same named thing, use that name exactly as the instances write it, without a gloss.
edits.old: Write a concise title naming the category these instances belong to, rather than describing the instances as text. If every instance expresses the same named thing, use that name exactly as the instances write it, without a gloss. Otherwise, name the smallest genuine category containing what every instance refers to.

edits.new: Interpret the quoted text within each instance together, using the group to clarify its meaning. The instances may express different levels or aspects of the same topic; they need not all be the same kind of thing. Every instance must fit under the title. Judge this by meaning, not by shared wording or text format, unless wording or format is itself being discussed.
edits.old: Interpret the quoted text within each instance together. Judge category membership by its meaning, not by shared wording or text format, unless wording or format is itself being discussed.

edits.new: Make relationships that define the topic explicit in the title.
edits.old: Make relationships that define the category explicit in the title. Each instance must support the title's full meaning on its own.
